n: Otaru Masazushi Honten (おたる政寿司 本店)
w: Founded 1938 on Otaru's Sushiya-dōri — the old guard of the city's sushi, as loved by locals as by visitors. 11:00–15:00, 17:00–21:00.

dish: soup curry (rich or light broth, shrimp-dashi option)
n: Soup Curry Picante, Kita 13-jō Honten (ピカンティ)
address: Near Hokkaido University (Kita 13-jō), Kita-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: One of the founding soup-curry houses (1996), by Hokkaido University — vegetable-heavy curries with a choice of rich, light or shrimp-dashi broth.

n: Kushiro Washō Market (釧路和商市場)
w: Kushiro's 1954 indoor fish market of ~60 stalls, home of the katte-don — buy a bowl of rice, then walk the stalls choosing each topping.
Seventy-plus years at the charcoal hearth in the city that claims to have invented robatayaki — counter seats only around the fire, fish grilled in front of you.
